notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Update notes:

Fixed a crash if you tried to cast spells while inside a square where Darkness had been cast.

Some changes to the way text is handled inside the dungeon. The textbox wraps differently if you're in widescreen mode, where it's no longer covered by the minimap. If text overflows the dungeon box, it now pushes itself up instead of down (to avoid text going off the screen and becoming unreadable.)

If you encounter any problems please report on the discussion thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/211340/discussions/0/3422185980119906214/

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Update notes:

Fixed a bug in the Valentines Planning diary entry (the entry was incorrectly formatted, and so would crash if you tried to read it.). The fix also works with old saves. I haven't seen any other reports of unreadable diary entries, but if there are any the fix may fix them as well.

Improved behaviour when switching between compact and widescreen modes - previously some of the UI would be messed up until you quit and restarted the game, now the buttons go to the right place immediately.

If you encounter any problems please report on the discussion thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/211340/discussions/0/3057364785111029618/

notes.title: Minor Patch (Jan 30 2016)
notes.notes: Fixing a couple of small issues with character creation, including one that would constantly reset the name back to Mary Sue when you changed other settings, and better handling for keyboard controls.

notes.title: Big changes in beta - El Capitan and other fixes!
notes.notes:
We're currently wrapping up a big overhaul of the engine to get it running on more computers and to fix some longstanding technical issues in the dungeons. Full details at:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/211340/discussions/0/458604254464533473/

If you own the game and have a chance to look over the new version, it would be greatly appreciated. You will need to switch your version into Beta to test the new build. 

Please post any questions or followup comments in the forum discussion thread so we can keep them straight!

Hope you've had a good holiday!
